activity_context.topic_title: The Characteristic Equation of a Matrix

feedback.problem:
Find the characteristic equation of the matrix 
$B=[\begin{aligned}1 & -4 & 3 \\ 0 & -2 & 0 \\ -3 & 5 & 1\end{aligned}].$
feedback.worked_solution:
First, we find the matrix $\,B-\lambda I:$
﻿﻿﻿

$$
B-\lambda I=[\begin{aligned}1-\lambda  & -4 & 3 \\ 0 & -2-\lambda  & 0 \\ -3 & 5 & 1-\lambda \end{aligned}]
$$

The characteristic equation is $det(B-\lambda I)=0.$ 

Expanding the determinant across the $2$nd row, we obtain the following:  

$$
\begin{aligned}det(B-\lambda I) & =0 \\ |\begin{aligned}1-\lambda  & -4 & 3 \\ 0 & -2-\lambda  & 0 \\ -3 & 5 & 1-\lambda \end{aligned}| & =0 \\ (-2-\lambda )|\begin{aligned}1-\lambda  & 3 \\ -3 & 1-\lambda \end{aligned}| & =0 \\ (-2-\lambda )((1-\lambda )(1-\lambda )-(3)(-3)) & =0 \\ (\lambda +2)({\lambda }^{2}-2\lambda +10) & =0\end{aligned}
$$
